events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched in the United States on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed the Radio Star" as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? MTV launched on this day in 1981, kicking off with The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. Did it really kill radio? We think not!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring hit singles like "Supersonic" and "Live Forever".

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe', an album that defined a generation. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock. Three days that changed music history forever.

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the "King of Rock and Roll," passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King. On this day in 1977, we lost Elvis Presley, but his music lives on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and tragically passed away six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur, a voice that continues to resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Paying tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking talent left us too soon. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like "Come Together" and "Something".

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and a distinctive voice in British rock, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic song "Imagine" as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and on the album of the same name in September 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' by John Lennon continues to be a timeless anthem for peace. Released on this day.

events.title: First iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, a revolutionary portable digital music player, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? On this day, Apple changed how we listen to music forever with its groundbreaking release.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating decades of 007's iconic adventures and unforgettable soundtracks.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940. He passed away in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His vision for peace and his music continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the iconic British actor, comedian, and writer, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! A true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: More than just an album, it's 'The White Album'. On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' diverse and groundbreaking 1968 masterpiece.
